body:
I was able to reproduce this issue on my machine: 
Godot v4.5.dev (89825015f) - macOS Sonoma (14.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 Pro (Apple7) - Apple M1 Pro (10 threads)

However, I got a different backtrace:
```
handle_crash: Program crashed with signal 11
Engine version: Godot Engine v4.5.dev.custom_build (89825015f1723c081613ee7240c594e81719961e)
Dumping the backtrace. Please include this when reporting the bug to the project developer.
[1] 1   libsystem_platform.dylib            0x00000001855e3584 _sigtramp + 56
[2] Particles2DEditorPlugin::_selection_changed() (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 60
[3] Object::emit_signalp(StringName const&, Variant const**, int) (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 600
[4] EditorSelection::_emit_change() (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 64
[5] CallQueue::_call_function(Callable const&, Variant const*, int, bool) (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 336
[6] CallQueue::flush() (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 352
[7] SceneTree::physics_process(double) (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 244
[8] Main::iteration() (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 596
[9] OS_MacOS::pre_wait_observer_cb(__CFRunLoopObserver*, unsigned long, void*) (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 124
[10] 10  CoreFoundation                      0x000000018569187c __CFRUNLOOP_IS_CALLING_OUT_TO_AN_OBSERVER_CALLBACK_FUNCTION__ + 36
[11] 11  CoreFoundation                      0x0000000185691768 __CFRunLoopDoObservers + 536
[12] 12  CoreFoundation                      0x0000000185690e90 __CFRunLoopRun + 1028
[13] 13  CoreFoundation                      0x0000000185690434 CFRunLoopRunSpecific + 608
[14] 14  HIToolbox                           0x000000018fe3419c RunCurrentEventLoopInMode + 292
[15] 15  HIToolbox                           0x000000018fe33fd8 ReceiveNextEventCommon + 648
[16] 16  HIToolbox                           0x000000018fe33d30 _BlockUntilNextEventMatchingListInModeWithFilter + 76
[17] 17  AppKit                              0x0000000188eefd68 _DPSNextEvent + 660
[18] 18  AppKit                              0x00000001896e5808 -[NSApplication(NSEventRouting) _nextEventMatchingEventMask:untilDate:inMode:dequeue:] + 700
[19] 19  AppKit                              0x0000000188ee309c -[NSApplication run] + 476
[20] main (in godot.macos.editor.arm64) + 224
[21] 21  dyld                                0x000000018522a0e0 start + 2360
-- END OF BACKTRACE --
```
I'm not too sure what `libsystem_platform.dylib` is doing here, but the crash seems to do with the _selection_changed method in the editor plugin.

Edit: After compiling with a dev_build, it appears that `GPUParticles2D* Object::cast_to<GPUParticles2D>(Object*) (godot/./core/object/object.h:797)` has the issue
Thanks for looking into it. I did a quick check and it looks like #102249 / [e54a4408ad533025c7e1581a983e0ac2bf9796e6] is the culprit.

Tested This on:
`v4.5.dev.custom_build [8bd9cdeea]  Godot v4.5.dev (8bd9cdeea) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400F @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)`
Didn't seem to work, but tested it on WSL and did get the crash. Seems to not occur to Windows, or at least for me.

WSL Specifications:
`v4.5.dev1.official [97241ffea] Godot v4.5.dev1 - Ubuntu 24.04.2 LTS 24.04 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - (software emulation on CPU) llvmpipe (LLVM 19.1.1, 256 bits) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-11400F @ 2.60GHz (12 threads)`

Thanks for the ping. I'll see if I can track this down and do a fix over the weekend.

EDIT: Nvm I see @PhairZ did a PR. Thanks a lot!
